init.title: Advanced features (optional)
init.description: Everything below stays blank/off for monitoring only. Fill in the SSH fields for the 'OBS' switch (starts/stops OBS on the machine, requires OpenSSH Server on Windows and a Scheduled Task, see docs). 'Enable OBS control' additionally unlocks switches for stream/recording start/stop plus dropdowns to switch profile and scene collection. 'Enable scene tree' adds switches for source visibility and filters per scene/source, usable via the bundled dashboard card (see docs) - all of it only usable while OBS is running (exception: the 'OBS' switch itself and the 'OBS running' sensor).

set_settings.name: Set OBS settings
set_settings.description: Pushes raw OBS source or filter settings straight from an automation or script - the same thing the gear-icon dialog on the 'OBS Scene Tree' card does, just as a service instead of by hand. Only the fields you give are changed; everything else is left as-is.

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: The fields to set, as an object, e.g. {"text": "Live now!"} for a text source. Raw field names are shown in the card's gear-icon dialog.
